About the University

The University of Melbourne is a public research university located in Melbourne, Australia. Founded in 1853, it is Australia's second oldest university and the oldest in Victoria. It ranks consistently as one of the leading higher education hubs in the Asia-Pacific.

Campus Life

Located on the edge of downtown Melbourne, the Parkville campus features stunning sandstone buildings alongside modern laboratories. Students enjoy rich cultural activities, coffee hubs, and active sports clubs.
